name: Crying Wojak Mask
aka: Pretending To Be Happy, Hiding Crying Behind A Mask
look: A crude black-and-white Wojak drawing of a bald man wearing a plain white oval mask with a simple smiling face, held on by a strap. Behind the mask, his bloodshot red eye streams blue tears and his clenched teeth show.
use: The smiling mask is the cheerful face someone shows the world, and the crying Wojak behind it is how they really feel. Captions set up a situation where someone acts fine while quietly falling apart.
slots: what they say or show on the outside, on or beside the smiling mask
how they really feel or what is really going on, near the crying face
examples: Haha no worries, it happens to everyone!
Sure, I'd love to help you move this weekend
Had three plans and a nap scheduled
describe: wojak holding a smiley face mask over his tears
sad drawn guy hiding tears behind a happy mask
bald doodle man pretending to smile while crying underneath
fake smile mask with tears running down behind it
feels guy putting on a happy face but sad inside
